originalIndependentReview.rationale: Read complete cached Nobel API records for every claimed person/prize and CC0 terms. Compared names, motivation, status, lifespan, award year, historical institutional name/city/country and original-record hash. Award-year relevance is explicit context, not year-long employment. Reviewed institutional association to accepted frameworks: Strasbourg1909 German Empire, Calcutta1930 British India, Tunis1928 French protectorate, Moscow USSR Soviet Union, Heidelberg1954 Federal Republic. All other listed cities fit their dated framework envelopes. countryNow, birthplace and nationality are unused. Occupied/dependent associations do not assert sovereignty or regime endorsement. Different announcement years and unmatched frameworks remain held in acquisition records. Non-Nobel people and non-award years remain explicit gaps.
